title: On the Pseudo-Mixing of Kac's Walk
abstract: arXiv:2608.17374v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Motivated by a conjecture of Vaikuntanathan and Zamir, we study the pseudo-mixing of Kac's walk on $\mathrm{SO}(n)$: whether short trajectories are indistinguishable from Haar measure by low-complexity tests. We prove that the first $k$ columns mix in Wasserstein distance in $O(n(k+\log n)\log n)$ steps for fixed accuracy, resolving a conjecture of Oliveira. Combining this with a representation-theoretic variance bound, we show that if $T=\omega(nk(k+\log n)\log n)$, then every degree-$k$ polynomial normalized to have unit Haar variance has expectation under the $T$-step law within $o(1)$ of its Haar expectation. As an application, we show that this pseudo-mixing estimate can be used to prove the effectiveness of a fast Johnson--Lindenstrauss transform with the usual target dimension.

translated_title: 论Kac游走中的伪混合性质
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17374v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：受Vaikuntanathan和Zamir猜想的启发，我们研究了Kac游走在$\mathrm{SO}(n)$上的伪混合性质：即短轨迹是否在低复杂度测试下与Haar测度不可区分。我们证明了在固定精度下，前$k$列在Wasserstein距离下于$O(n(k+\log n)\log n)$步内混合，解决了Oliveira的一个猜想。结合表示论中的方差界，我们进一步表明：若$T=\omega(nk(k+\log n)\log n)$，则任何归一化到单位Haar方差的$k$次多项式，在$T$步演化后的期望与其Haar期望之差为$o(1)$。作为应用，我们展示了这一伪混合估计可用于证明具有通常目标维度的快速Johnson–Lindenstrauss变换的有效性。
tldr: 本文解决了Kac游走伪混合的猜想，证明了前k列在Wasserstein距离下的快速混合，并利用该结果验证了快速Johnson–Lindenstrauss变换的有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper resolves a conjecture on pseudo-mixing of Kac's walk, proving fast Wasserstein mixing of the first k columns and using it to validate the effectiveness of a fast Johnson–Lindenstrauss transform.
